source.note: packages/xezar/mutation/shards.mjs `loadWeights` reads this to balance the nightly MCP mutation gate's shards on MEASURED per-file cost — the sum of `coveredBy.length` across a file's mutants in Stryker's own JSON report, i.e. how many tests Stryker reruns to check each mutant under `coverageAnalysis: 'perTest'`. Byte size (the pre-#443 balance) has no relationship to that number; see docs/testing/coverage-gaps.md § 10.8 for the incident this snapshot fixes.
source.refresh: Regenerate when a shard starts approaching the 300-minute ceiling again, or after a PR that adds broad tests spanning several MCP modules (the kind that inflated this snapshot in the first place). Download each `mutation-report-<N>` artifact from the latest complete nightly run and sum `coveredBy.length` per file across all of them; a file this snapshot has no entry for falls back to byte size automatically, so a partial refresh is always safe.

estimatedPaths.note: These 7 files sat in shard 6 of run 35175010173, which never uploaded a report — the shard was still running when the workflow's 300-minute ceiling cancelled it. Their weights below are no longer the raw carry-over from the previous complete night: proof run 35199363744 (#443's own 8-shard fix, 2026-09-17) showed the carry-over was still far too low for `bridge.ts` and `tools/task-create.ts` specifically — a shard holding `bridge.ts` plus ~128k of otherwise-ordinary weight ran 4h54m against this file's own ~150k-weight, no-estimated-file shards' ~1h49m, and the shard holding `tools/task-create.ts` was still running when the 300-minute ceiling cancelled it (job `Mutants 6`, run 35199363744). The weights below for all 7 are back-calculated from that run's own per-shard wall-clock time (see docs/testing/coverage-gaps.md § 10.8), not from a real `coveredBy` sum — `tools/task-create.ts` and `bridge.ts` in particular are a LOWER bound only, since neither shard produced a report to sum. Refresh all 7 with real `coveredBy` sums the next time a complete run's shard reports are available.
